answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can transact, like a mesa of trust that only rises with verified work. Each new identity must earn attestations from established peers, and each attestation costs the attester a small bond, so a fake army needs a spiral of paid endorsements instead of free copies. Quartz-clear audit trails record who vouched for whom, so if one identity is caught cheating, the whole vouching chain loses its stake. An attacker must therefore buy credibility identity by identity, making a thousand fakes a thousand times as expensive as one honest agent.
